kind: Static iPhone proposals; not simulator captures

screens.title: Existing layout
screens.description: The current seven-column layout in the selected theme. The all-day area uses 160 points.
screens.notes: Static layout reference with the same sample events as the alternatives. Narrow event labels are part of the existing layout.

screens.title: A · Compact seven days
screens.description: Keep the full week. Collapse all-day items into one 44-point row.
screens.notes: Selected. Gain 116 points for timed events. Tap Trip +4 to inspect all five items. Event names remain narrow.

screens.title: B · Week with an agenda
screens.description: Keep seven days above a readable list for the selected day.
screens.notes: Alternative. Tap a date to select its column and agenda. Tap an event to open its detail. Open day gives the full timeline. Each pane scrolls independently.

screens.title: C · Three-day zoom
screens.description: Give each day more width. Keep the same time axis and overlap placement.
screens.notes: Choose 3 days from the existing view menu. Swipe horizontally to move through dates. Tap a date to open Day. This option shows less of the week.

screens.title: Inspect all-day items
screens.description: Trip +4 opens the selected date’s full list in a sheet.
screens.notes: Keep the event, chore, and all three meals. Done returns to the same week position. This sheet is a proposed interaction.

screens.title: Open the selected day
screens.description: Open day shows the existing Day timeline. Back returns to Week.
screens.notes: For option B, tapping a date selects the agenda. Open day is the separate drill-down action. For A and C, tapping a date can open Day directly.

screens.title: Choose a week layout
screens.description: Use a submenu in the existing Calendar view menu.
screens.notes: Keep Year, Month, Day, and Week. Add week layout choices inside that menu. Do not add an inner tab bar. This menu shows the alternatives together for review.

screens.title: Start near the first event
screens.description: A future week opens near its first timed event. The sample starts at 16:00 for a 17:30 event.
screens.notes: For this week, start near now. For another week, use its first daytime event. Keep manual scroll positions. Do not reset the viewport when data refreshes.

screens.title: Compact all-day · dark
screens.description: The selected layout with the approved dark tokens.
screens.notes: Keep the source calendar colours distinct. All-day items remain available through the compact row.

screens.title: Compact all-day · small iPhone
screens.description: The selected layout on a 375 × 667-point iPhone.
screens.notes: Keep the full seven-day timeline. The floating tab bar stays over content. More hours remain available through vertical scroll.

screens.title: Week · large text
screens.description: Use the existing date picker and full-width agenda at accessibility text sizes.
screens.notes: Remove the split layout at accessibility sizes. Keep readable labels and the existing week agenda fallback.
